description: Identify recurring themes in positive and negative reviews to understand what customers truly value and what frustrates them
facilitation_prompts: What words or phrases appear repeatedly in positive reviews?|What complaints show up most frequently?|Are there seasonal patterns in review sentiment?

description: Analyze the spread of star ratings to understand overall satisfaction trends and polarization
facilitation_prompts: What percentage of reviews fall into each star category?|Are most reviews extremely positive or negative?|What triggers middle-range 3-star reviews?

description: Compare review themes and ratings against competitors to identify differentiation opportunities
facilitation_prompts: What do competitors' reviews say about them?|What do you do better based on reviews?|What gaps exist that no one is solving?

description: Track the emotional arc in customer reviews to understand experience highs and lows
facilitation_prompts: Where do customers express delight?|What moments trigger frustration or disappointment?|Which touchpoints get the most emotional reactions?

description: Evaluate current review response patterns to identify gaps and opportunities
facilitation_prompts: What percentage of reviews do you currently respond to?|How quickly do you typically respond?|Which review types get ignored most often?

description: Lead every response with genuine acknowledgment of the customer's experience before addressing specifics
facilitation_prompts: How can you validate their feelings first?|What specific detail from their review can you reference?|How would you want to be responded to in their situation?

description: Infuse brand personality into responses while maintaining professionalism and authenticity
facilitation_prompts: What makes your voice unique?|How can you be warm without being fake?|What personality traits should shine through?

description: Reference specific details from positive reviews to show genuine reading and gratitude
facilitation_prompts: What unique detail did they mention?|What can you thank them for specifically?|How can you make them feel truly seen?

description: Structure negative review responses to acknowledge issue identify root cause and present concrete solution
facilitation_prompts: What went wrong and why?|What have you done or will you do to fix it?|How can you prevent this in the future?

description: Know when to move conversations from public to private channels for resolution
facilitation_prompts: When should you offer to continue offline?|What contact information should you provide?|How do you maintain professionalism while protecting privacy?

description: Transform criticism into demonstration of your commitment to improvement and excellence
facilitation_prompts: How can this complaint showcase your values?|What positive action can you highlight?|How does this align with your mission to serve better?

description: Craft responses to positive reviews that amplify key selling points and invite deeper engagement
facilitation_prompts: Which praise points align with your positioning?|How can you encourage them to share more?|What invitation can you extend for continued relationship?

description: Identify optimal moments in customer journey to request reviews when satisfaction is highest
facilitation_prompts: When are customers most delighted?|What milestone moments trigger joy?|Which touchpoint naturally invites feedback?

description: Develop review request systems across Google Yelp Facebook and industry-specific platforms
facilitation_prompts: Which platforms matter most to your business?|Where do ideal customers look for reviews?|How can you make requesting easy across channels?

description: Create authentic non-pushy review request messages that feel genuine and appreciative
facilitation_prompts: How can you ask without sounding desperate?|What value can you remind them of?|How do you make it easy and fast for them?

description: Build automated yet personal follow-up cadences that increase review submission rates
facilitation_prompts: When should the first request go out?|How many follow-ups are appropriate?|What's your graceful exit point?

description: Navigate the ethics and platform rules around review incentives without violating guidelines
facilitation_prompts: What's allowed vs prohibited on each platform?|How can you reward without buying reviews?|What authentic appreciation can you offer?

description: Recognize and appropriately flag reviews that appear inauthentic or violate platform policies
facilitation_prompts: What makes this review seem suspicious?|Does it violate platform guidelines?|What evidence can you gather for flagging?

description: Develop rapid-response systems for serious complaints or reputation threats
facilitation_prompts: What constitutes a review crisis?|Who needs to be involved in response?|What's your 24-hour action plan?

description: Know what to address publicly vs privately when handling sensitive customer issues
facilitation_prompts: What must be acknowledged publicly?|What details should stay private?|How do you protect both parties?

description: Professionally correct inaccurate information without being defensive or argumentative
facilitation_prompts: What specific facts need correction?|How can you present truth without attacking?|What evidence can you provide?

description: Generate positive review momentum to naturally push down negative reviews in search results
facilitation_prompts: How many positive reviews do you need?|What's your target review velocity?|How can you systematically request from happy customers?

description: Ensure all review responses align with established brand voice and values across team members
facilitation_prompts: Do all responses sound like the same brand?|Are there voice inconsistencies between team members?|What voice guidelines need documentation?

description: Create response templates that serve as starting points but require personalization for authenticity
facilitation_prompts: Where should templates be flexible vs fixed?|What must always be customized?|How do you avoid sounding robotic?

description: Establish recurring review analysis sessions to track trends and refine strategy over time
facilitation_prompts: What metrics should you track monthly?|How are response times trending?|What new patterns are emerging?

description: Develop training systems for team members who respond to reviews on behalf of the business
facilitation_prompts: Who can respond to reviews?|What guidelines do they need?|How do you ensure quality and consistency?

description: Mine competitor reviews for strategic insights about market needs and positioning opportunities
facilitation_prompts: What are customers asking competitors for?|What complaints reveal market gaps?|How can you differentiate based on review intel?

description: Transform common review themes into marketing content blog topics and FAQ resources
facilitation_prompts: What review questions become FAQ content?|Which praises become marketing copy?|How can reviews inform content strategy?

description: Leverage review keywords and themes to improve local search rankings and visibility
facilitation_prompts: What location-based keywords appear in reviews?|How can responses include SEO terms naturally?|What review content boosts local relevance?

description: Use review responses to deepen relationships and create pathways to repeat business
facilitation_prompts: How can responses invite return visits?|What exclusive offers can you mention?|How do you turn reviewers into advocates?
